questions.question:
Automated File Organizer
Create a Python program that scans a folder and automatically moves files into folders such as:
Documents/
Images/
Videos/
Audio/
Archives/
Others/

Bulk File Renaming Tool
Build a program that accepts a folder and naming pattern and renames multiple files automatically.

Duplicate File Detector
Create a Python program that identifies duplicate files using file metadata or file hashes and generates a duplicate report.

Automated CSV/JSON Report Generator
Read data from CSV/JSON files, analyze the data, and automatically generate a summarized report containing statistics and important records.

Complete File & Data Automation System
Combine the previous features into a single menu-driven Python application with:
File organization 
Bulk renaming 
Duplicate detection 
CSV/JSON processing 
Report generation 
Exception handling 
Logging 
Modular code structure
